_eligibility_text:
**ELIGIBILITY FOR UNIVERSITIES** Universities recognized by Government/UGC are only eligible for nomination under this scheme.
**ELIGIBLE SPORTS DISCIPLINES** Sports disciplines to be considered for the MAKA Trophy Award will be based on the following conditions: 1) The sports disciplines should be recognized by the MYAS; and 2) The sports disciplines should also be part of Olympics/Asian Games/Commonwealth Games. 3) Apart from the above, the following three sports disciplines are included based on popularity / indignity: (i) Chess, (ii) Kho-kho, (iii) Cricket
